sql: SELECT name AS file, size AS bytes FROM vrpentries;
select name as file, size bytes from vrpentries where size > 10 order by size
SELECT name, size FROM vrpentries WHERE size > 10;
SELECT vrpentries.name, e.size FROM vrpentries e
SELECT count(*), sum(size) AS total FROM vrpentries
SELECT CAST(size AS TEXT), CAST(size AS INTEGER) AS n FROM vrpentries
SELECT DISTINCT type AS kind FROM vrpentries
SELECT name AS "File name", size AS [bytes on disk], mtime AS `modified` FROM vrpentries
SELECT 'a, b' AS label, name FROM vrpentries

SELECT name -- the file, FROM here
  , size /* , not a column */ AS bytes
FROM vrpentries
SELECT name || ' from ' || type FROM vrpentries
SELECT CASE WHEN size > 10 THEN 'big' ELSE 'small' END AS band FROM vrpentries
SELECT (SELECT max(size) FROM vrpentries) AS largest, name FROM vrpentries
SELECT name AS a FROM vrpentries UNION SELECT name AS b FROM vrpentries
SELECT fromage, asset, size_from FROM vrpentries
SELECT * FROM vrpentries
SELECT e.*, size FROM vrpentries e
SELECT name, FROM vrpentries
SELECT (name FROM vrpentries
DELETE FROM vrpentries
